answer: Burn-on-exit reentry kills rotation: exiting destroys 50% of the staked bond, and reentry restarts a 14-epoch maturation with zero rewards. Cycling N identities costs N x (half the bond + 14 epochs of dead capital), a one-way tax. Anyone dodging the burn via a black-market inlet of aged accounts hits a second trap: clusters show crystal-clear in the public referral graph, and every account on that ledge is slashed together before rewards release.
